items.title: Poços de Caldas (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 7 #1
items.en_title: Poços de Caldas (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 7 #1
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Poços de Caldas (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,479,000; proposals close Dec 7, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
